输入结构解析 —— 数据是怎么喂给 Jev 的

每一步都是一次 POST /v1/systemone 请求，请求体 = { state, model, questions }。 代码负责枚举全部合法落点并模拟后果，把数字词化成自然语言；Jev 不读数字、不做算术，只读词，返回带概率分布的判断。

① state.game —— 局面词化（第 1 步真实值）

rules"Standard Tetris. Board is 10 columns wide and 20 rows tall. Rows fill left to right; a full row disappears. The game is…
board_rows_top_to_bottom["..........", "..........", "..........", … 共 20 项]
legend"# is a filled cell, . is an empty cell. The first row is the top of the board."
column_heights_left_to_right[0, 0, 0, … 共 10 项]
stack_height"very low"
holes_in_stack"none"
surface"flat"
current_piece"Z"
next_piece"T"
lines_cleared_so_far0

② questions.placement —— 主问题：选哪个落点

Which placement of `game.current_piece` should the player choose? Each option describes the board after that placement.

优先级（权重全靠措辞顺序）：

  1. 1. Clearing lines is good. Clearing more lines at once is better.
  2. 2. Do not create holes. A placement with holes_created of none beats one that creates holes, unless the one with holes clears far more lines or the stack is dangerously high.
  3. 3. Keep the stack low. Prefer a lower stack_height_after and a height_change that does not grow the stack.
  4. 4. Keep the surface flat. Prefer surface_after of flat over slightly uneven, bumpy, or very jagged.
  5. 5. One deep well is acceptable because the next I piece can fill it. Several deep wells are bad.
  6. 6. When the stack is dangerously high, survival matters more than a clean surface.

每个候选落点一条 criteria，全部用词不用数，含显著事实（唯一/最高/最低等客观比较）。本局第 1 步共 17 个候选，示例 p0：

wherecolumns 1-3
lines_clearednone
holes_createdone hole
holes_uncoverednone
stack_height_aftervery low
height_changestack grows by several rows
surface_afterflat
wells_afterno deep wells

③ 投机问题（同请求随附，只进日志不影响落点）

strategy当前局面该用哪种策略（build_clean / clear_lines / repair_surface / survive）
board_health棋盘健康度打分：Clean / Fine / Rough / Critical
next_piece_fits下一块（next_piece）是否有明显干净的落位
